credits: Original geometry drawn for Verdant Reach under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md). Botanical reference: Nerium oleander, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nerium . No sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Crystal rule. Nerium oleander. REARING / displaying: a shrub of several stems rising from one low mound, swaying back then forward so the crown rears over the foe; narrow, leathery, dark green lance leaves in whorls of three, each with a pale midrib and a glossy rim, and a cluster of pink five-petal pinwheel flowers at every stem's end, the biggest (the head) at the top left. Gesture: the flower clusters draw in tight, then open outward past rest, hold and settle; stems, leaves and mound stay fixed. A dark leathery green dark slot under the oleander's pink mid tone. Sport: a white-flowered garden form (blush white in the mid slot).
